Script.name: Icesus-Loader
Script.script:
installRequested = nil
function downloadPackage(a,b) if installRequested then return end decho("<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>Downloading the Icesus Mudlet package...\n") downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.mpackage", "https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/releases/latest/download/Icesus.mpackage") end
function downloadFailed(event, message, file) if file ~= getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage" then return end if installRequested then return end decho("<190,0,0>[ FAIL ] - <0,160,0>The Icesus Mudlet package could not be downloaded: <190,190,190>"..tostring(message).."\n") decho([[<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>To install the Icesus Mudlet package, copy the following text (without line breaks) into the input line and send it:
lua function d(a,b)if not b:find("Icesus",1,true)then return end installPackage(b)os.remove(b)cecho("<gold>Package installed!\n")end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone","d")downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage","https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/releases/latest/download/Icesus.mpackage")
]]) end
function installReady(event, file) if file ~= getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage" then return end if installRequested then return end
decho("<0,160,0>[ OK ] - <190,100,50>The Icesus Mudlet package was downloaded successfully.\n") decho("<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>Installing... (this takes a few seconds.)\n") installRequested = true local installedBefore = getPackages() tempTimer(1, function() local ok, err = true, nil -- the command a failed download tells the player to paste installs and removes it itself if io.exists(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage") then ok, err = installPackage(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage") end if not ok and tostring(err):find("is already installed", 1, true) then return end if not ok then installRequested = false decho("<190,0,0>[ FAIL ] - <0,160,0>The Icesus Mudlet package could not be installed: <190,190,190>"..tostring(err).."\n") elseif #table.n_complement(getPackages(), installedBefore) == 0 then installRequested = false end end) uninstallPackage("icesus-loader") end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "downloadPackage") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "installReady") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", "downloadFailed")
